parameters.query: SELECT brand_id, ad_account_id, insights_last_fetched_at FROM brands WHERE ad_account_id IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(status,'active') = 'active';

INSERT INTO ad_metrics (date, brand_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, concept, angle, format, spend_zar, impressions, clicks, leads_raw, cpl, frequency, hook_rate, hold_rate)
SELECT x.date, x.brand_id, x.campaign_id, x.campaign_name, x.adset_id, x.adset_name, x.ad_id, x.ad_name, x.concept, x.angle, x.format, x.spend_zar, x.impressions, x.clicks, x.leads_raw, x.cpl, x.frequency, x.hook_rate, x.hold_rate
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(date date, brand_id uuid, campaign_id text, campaign_name text, adset_id text, adset_name text, ad_id text, ad_name text, concept text, angle text, format text, spend_zar numeric, impressions int, clicks int, leads_raw int, cpl numeric, frequency numeric, hook_rate numeric, hold_rate numeric)
ON CONFLICT (date, ad_id) DO UPDATE SET campaign_name = EXCLUDED.campaign_name, adset_name = EXCLUDED.adset_name, ad_name = EXCLUDED.ad_name, spend_zar = EXCLUDED.spend_zar, impressions = EXCLUDED.impressions, clicks = EXCLUDED.clicks, leads_raw = EXCLUDED.leads_raw, cpl = EXCLUDED.cpl, frequency = EXCLUDED.frequency, hook_rate = EXCLUDED.hook_rate, hold_rate = EXCLUDED.hold_rate
-- qualified / booked / attended / cost_per_* are NOT touched here: the join below (and W29 for broker quality) own them.
RETURNING 1;
